save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and lr_scheduler state to a file path
load_checkpoints: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a resume path and restore model, optimizer, and lr_scheduler state
save_acc_predictor: save an accuracy predictor object to a joblib file using args models_save_dir and current epoch
load_acc_predictor: load an accuracy predictor from a saved joblib file path and return the predictor object
copy_file: copy a file from a source path to a target path using shutil copyfile
